from dateutil.relativedelta import relativedelta

def calculate_duration(row):
    first = datetime.datetime.strptime(row['first_appeared'], '%Y-%m-%d')
    last = datetime.datetime.strptime(row['last_appeared'], '%Y-%m-%d')
    duration = relativedelta(last, first)
    return duration.years + duration.days / 365
